note: A product only moves to "verified" when someone links the public certificate or lab directory listing. Maker press releases do not count.

products.claim: Announced July 15, 2026 as the first UL 3700 plug-in microinverter. Coverage disagrees on the wording: some say "certified", at least one says "compliant".
The maker says the EZ1 plug-in microinverter is CSA certified to UL 3700. That is CSA Group testing against the UL standard, and it covers the inverter, not a full kit.

products.kind: Complete kit: four 300 W panels, four microinverters, gateway, mounts
products.claim: Reported to have earned certification for the whole kit, which would make it the only system-level claim so far. The testing lab is not named, and other sources said in August 2026 that no complete system had been certified.
